section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the analytic strategy for a single study examining the factor structure of the Malay BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2) using a two-step EFA-to-CFA approach. The Malay sample was split into two halves: one for exploratory factor analysis (EFA) with women (n=149) and men (n=157), and another for confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) with Malay women (n=121), Malay men (n=114), and Chinese participants (women n=120, men n=120). The section details the statistical methods, fit indices, and validity assessments planned for the study, including measurement invariance testing across sex and ethnicity, and convergent validity assessment using bivariate correlations with self-reported BMI and other measures.
